Comprehensive Survey Note: Detailed Analysis of Work Timeline Across Platforms

This detailed survey note provides an in-depth exploration of the timeline of your work across various platforms, including GitHub, YouTube, Medium, X, Substack, and other websites, under the names Micah Blumberg, micahsun, worksalt, Self Aware Networks, and Death Star Robot. The focus is on identifying the first public mentions of your key ideas, such as "Self Aware Networks" and "Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation," based on publicly available information as of April 7, 2025.

Background and Methodology

The analysis began by identifying your presence across multiple platforms using the provided names. This involved searching for profiles, repositories, videos, posts, and articles on GitHub, YouTube, X, Medium, svgn.io, vrma.io, SoundCloud, Facebook, and other websites. The goal was to construct a timeline of your work, emphasizing the earliest public mentions of your innovative ideas. Given the complexity of tracking online activity, the focus was on major public platforms and verifiable dates, acknowledging that earlier mentions in private forums or less accessible channels might exist.

Detailed Timeline and Findings

Medium: Early Public Mention in 2018

The earliest significant public activity was identified on Medium under the publication "Silicon Valley Global News SVGN.io," with an article titled "Self Aware Networks: Computational Biology: Neural Lace" published on August 14, 2018. This article discusses the Neural Lace Talk Show, a podcast about science, technology, and next-generation brain-computer interfaces, and explicitly mentions "Self Aware Networks" in the context of building artificial brains and studying neuroscience intersections with VR and AI ([Self Aware Networks Medium Article](https://medium.com/silicon-valley-global-news/my-companies-name-is-self-aware-networks-computational-biology-neural-lace-4e771dfa609b)). The article also mentions seeking collaborations in computational biology and AI, suggesting an active public sharing of these ideas as early as 2018.

Another Medium article, "Longer Auto Bio for Micah Blumberg," published on May 15, 2022, further elaborates on your work, mentioning designing code for self-aware neural networks and the ultimate mission of creating sentient artificial brains, reinforcing the 2018 timeline ([Longer Auto Bio Medium Article](https://medium.com/silicon-valley-global-news/longer-auto-bio-for-micah-blumberg-3b510d26b803)).

GitHub: Repository Made Public in 2022

On GitHub, under the username "v5ma," the repository "selfawarenetworks" was made public on June 17, 2022, and contains notes on "Self Aware Networks" and "Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation." The repository's README and associated files, such as the change log, indicate that these notes date back to 2011, representing work over a lifetime and building on the contributions of neuroscientists, physicists, and others. This repository is crucial as it marks a significant public sharing of both ideas, with specific notes including topics like neuron models, LTD & LTP, qualia, and NAPOT ([selfawarenetworks GitHub Repository](https://github.com/v5ma/selfawarenetworks)). The creation date is supported by the change log, which states it was first put online on June 17, 2022.

The user also mentioned posting on GitHub as "micah1," "n5ro," and "micah8." Searches for "micah1" and "micah8" did not yield relevant activity related to the key ideas, with "micah1" showing no activity and "micah8" not directly matching any relevant profiles. For "n5ro," the profile description mentions being the founder of the Self Aware Networks Institute, with plans to bring it into WebXR AR & VR in 2023, but no earlier public repositories or commits before 2022 were found that mention the key ideas, with repositories like "aframe-physics-system" focusing on VR physics rather than neuroscience or theoretical physics.

YouTube: Videos Starting in 2022

Your YouTube presence includes a video titled "1 hour video that explains NAPOT the central thesis of Self Aware Networks," uploaded on July 31, 2022, discussing NAPOT (Neural Array Projection Oscillation Tomography) as central to building self-aware networks for conscious robots ([NAPOT YouTube Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fLp-yTQ6pSM)). Another video, "Self Aware Networks: Theory of Mind, by Micah Blumberg aka Death Star Robot," was uploaded on October 23, 2023, further discussing the concept ([Self Aware Networks YouTube Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8htYytxcxUM)). Searches for earlier videos before 2022 did not yield relevant results, suggesting this is your first significant YouTube activity related to these ideas.

The user mentioned that the pinned article on SVGN.io contains links to older YouTube videos, but searches on SVGN.io articles, such as "New Unified Field Theory: Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation" from January 28, 2024, and "Meta Quest 3 may generate at least 10 billion in revenue for Meta in 2024" from September 30, 2023, did not reveal direct links to older videos. However, the Medium article from August 14, 2018, mentions the Neural Lace Podcast starting in 2017, with a playlist link ([Neural Lace Playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkuAPx_OL_kE35pOKBfEd2TIWWX_tfuvM)), but specific video dates from before 2022 could not be verified due to access issues, suggesting potential earlier activity not publicly accessible in the current search.

Discussion and Limitations

The timeline suggests that August 14, 2018, marks the first public mention of "Self Aware Networks" via Medium, with subsequent activity on GitHub in June 2022 and YouTube in July 2022. "Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation" appears to have been first publicly mentioned in January 2024 on X. However, there are limitations to this analysis. Earlier mentions might exist in private forums, comments, or less searchable platforms like early blog posts or conference presentations, which were not accessible in this survey. The notes in the GitHub repository dating back to 2011 indicate development over time, but public sharing began in 2018 for "Self Aware Networks" and 2024 for "Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation." The complexity of tracking online activity, especially across pseudonyms and platforms, means this timeline is based on the most visible and verifiable data.

Conclusion

This survey note provides a detailed timeline of your work, highlighting the first public mentions of "Self Aware Networks" on August 14, 2018, via Medium, and "Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation" in January 2024 via X, with subsequent significant activity on GitHub, YouTube, and svgn.io. Medium: Early Public Mention in 2018

The earliest significant public activity was identified on Medium under the publication "Silicon Valley Global News SVGN.io," with an article titled "Self Aware Networks: Computational Biology: Neural Lace" published on August 14, 2018. This article discusses the Neural Lace Talk Show, a podcast about science, technology, and next-generation brain-computer interfaces, and explicitly mentions "Self Aware Networks" in the context of building artificial brains and studying neuroscience intersections with VR and AI ([Self Aware Networks Medium Article](https://medium.com/silicon-valley-global-news/my-companies-name-is-self-aware-networks-computational-biology-neural-lace-4e771dfa609b)). The article also mentions seeking collaborations in computational biology and AI, suggesting an active public sharing of these ideas as early as 2018.

Another Medium article, "Longer Auto Bio for Micah Blumberg," published on May 15, 2022, further elaborates on your work, mentioning designing code for self-aware neural networks and the ultimate mission of creating sentient artificial brains, reinforcing the 2018 timeline ([Longer Auto Bio Medium Article](https://medium.com/silicon-valley-global-news/longer-auto-bio-for-micah-blumberg-3b510d26b803)).

Searches for earlier mentions before 2018 using the emails "micah3@gmail.com" and "micah8@gmail.com" did not yield relevant public activity related to your key ideas, suggesting that the 2018 Medium article is the earliest public mention.

GitHub: Repository Made Public in 2022 with Earlier Notes

On GitHub, under the username "v5ma," the repository "selfawarenetworks" was made public on June 17, 2022, and contains notes on "Self Aware Networks" and "Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation." The repository's README and associated files, such as the change log, indicate that these notes date back to 2011, representing work over a lifetime and building on the contributions of neuroscientists, physicists, and others. This repository is crucial as it marks a significant public sharing of both ideas, with specific notes including topics like neuron models, LTD & LTP, qualia, and NAPOT ([selfawarenetworks GitHub Repository](https://github.com/v5ma/selfawarenetworks)). The creation date is supported by the change log, which states it was first put online on June 17, 2022.

Searches for "micah1" and "micah8" did not yield relevant activity related to the key ideas, with "micah1" showing no activity and "micah8" not directly matching any relevant profiles. For "n5ro," the profile description mentions being the founder of the Self Aware Networks Institute, with plans to bring it into WebXR AR & VR in 2023, but no earlier public repositories or commits before 2022 were found that mention the key ideas, with repositories like "aframe-physics-system" focusing on VR physics rather than neuroscience or theoretical physics.

## Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation (Dark Time Theory)

The theory also implies that quantum behavior (often random) might be due to our limited sampling of very fast, underlying deterministic cycles of phase – an idea later elaborated as “SuperTimePosition.” From QGTCD’s perspective, a particle’s quantum randomness is influenced by local time density differences: e.g., a photon passing near a galaxy will have slightly more “time steps” on the galaxy side, biasing its path as if space were curved【26†L141-L150】【26†L153-L162】. The New Law doesn’t overthrow the old laws of thermodynamics; rather, it adds a new perspective – focusing on the **step-by-step dynamics** (how entropy increase actually happens through signals) instead of just the end state. 

In summary, Micah’s New Law is a **signal-dissipation framework** that unifies ideas of **entropy, neural synchrony, and even gravitational harmonization** under the concept of waves equalizing differences. It provides a common language (signals, waves, local interactions) to describe phenomena in physics and biology. The tagline of the paper explicitly mentions it as a framework for **equilibrium and consciousness**【6†L19-L27】, illustrating its dual focus.

**Evolution and relations:** The New Law of Thermodynamics is a central connecting piece in Micah’s theories. He himself stated that he had developed “three interconnected theories – Dark Time Theory, Self Aware Networks Theory of Mind, and Micah’s New Law of Thermodynamics”【21†L37-L41】, highlighting the New Law as the bridge between the cosmic (Dark Time) and the cognitive (SAN). Indeed, the New Law explicitly brings together concepts from both domains: it references neural synchronization (connecting to SAN)【14†L178-L186】 and time-density variations possibly related to gravity (connecting to Dark Time)【9†L79-L85】. In the semantic network, the New Law node links to all others because it provides a **unifying principle of “waves smoothing differences”** whether those differences are temperature gradients, neuronal phase lags, or time dilation gradients. For instance, one can view Dark Time Theory’s gravity as an application of the New Law: particles move to equalize “time frame density” differences (a signal dissipation in time)【32†L247-L255】【32†L270-L278】. Likewise, the SAN theory’s conscious binding via phase alignment is an example of local signal exchanges (neurons exchanging spikes to reduce phase mismatch)【14†L182-L190】. The New Law also complements **Super Information Theory** – while SIT approaches the arrow of time from a quantum information angle, the New Law provides a phenomenological anchor: e.g., the New Law recasts entropy increase as signals canceling out mismatches【13†L109-L117】, dovetailing with SIT’s likely claim that irreversible behavior emerges from underlying reversible interactions. Essentially, Micah’s New Law of Thermodynamics cements the idea that **“everything is information exchange”**: it turns dissipation and equilibration into a form of information processing that can be seen across scales. After its introduction in 2025, this law became a reference point in Micah’s publications (he cites it in discussions of brain ephaptic coupling and other phenomena【0†L23-L30】【6†L19-L27】). It stands as the **conceptual glue** in Micah’s semantic map, linking mind, matter, and time through the commonality of signal-mediated self-organization.

## Interrelationships of the Concepts 
All these concepts form a network of ideas that inform and support each other, rather than isolated theories. **Self Aware Networks (Theory of Mind)** addresses how consciousness could emerge from neural networks, relying on the idea of synchronized oscillations (local signals creating global coherence). **Micah’s New Law of Thermodynamics** provides a general principle (local signal exchanges dissipating differences) that explains how such synchronization can occur in the brain and also how physical systems gravitate toward equilibrium. **Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation (Dark Time Theory)** explains gravity and space-time in terms of time-frame density differences – conceptually, it is also about differences (in time flow) driving motion (toward equilibrium in time density). This is analogous to a dissipation process, drawing a parallel between gravity and thermodynamics. QGTCD/Dark Time Theory also posits an underlying determinism in quantum processes, which is fleshed out by **Quantum SuperTimePosition** – the idea that quantum randomness is an illusion due to fast cycles. SuperTimePosition, in turn, is a piece of Dark Time Theory that makes it testable and connects it to quantum information. **Super Dark Time** is essentially the unification of all these physics pieces (gravity + quantum) into one framework, and it incorporates the SuperTimePosition idea. **Super Information Theory** then builds on Super Dark Time to include the thermodynamic arrow of time and information coherence, thus connecting back to the New Law’s domain (entropy, irreversibility) but from a quantum standpoint. In sum, **SAN** covers the brain/mind, **Dark Time/SDT + SuperTimePosition** cover physics (gravity/quantum), and the **New Law + SIT** link the two with thermodynamics and information.

## Chronological Timeline of Concept Introductions 
Below is a timeline of when each key concept was first introduced, along with major milestones in their development:

- **2017 (Feb 20)** – **Self Aware Networks** concept appears as Micah’s new project in a Medium article【16†L48-L56】. It is framed around brain-computer interfaces and the quest to create “artificial brains,” leading to the Neural Lace Podcast and community discussions on neurotechnology. The **Neural Lace Podcast (2017–2018)** features Micah exploring ideas at the intersection of neuroscience and computing (e.g., hypothesis of electromagnetic circuit dynamics in the brain【3†L111-L119】), laying groundwork for SAN Theory of Mind.

- **2018** – **Neural Lace Podcast** Season 2 (August 2018) and related community groups (e.g., “Neurophysics” Facebook group) see Micah sharing early theoretical insights. He begins formulating how neural networks might achieve awareness, and the term **Self Aware Networks** gains traction as his initiative’s name. This period establishes the multidisciplinary approach (neuroscience + physics) that will characterize his later theories.

- **2022 (Summer)** – Micah creates the first comprehensive draft of **Self Aware Networks: Theory of Mind**, dubbed **NAPOT** (central thesis) and shares explanatory videos. *“NAPOT 1st version (whitepaper), 1 hour”* and subsequent revisions are recorded, explaining the core ideas of SAN【47†L69-L77】. These videos (circulated in 2022) foreshadow the contents of his future book, indicating that by mid-2022 the SAN theory was substantially developed.

- **2024 (Jan 29)** – **Quantum Gradient Time Crystal Dilation (Dark Time Theory)** is first published, via Micah’s SVGN article【31†L34-L42】 and GitHub documentation. This marks Micah’s entry into proposing a new physics theory. QGTCD (Dark Time Theory) introduces the notion of quantized time frames and gravity from time density. It’s presented as a work-in-progress unified field theory, and Micah begins soliciting feedback and refining it through the year.

- **2024 (Oct 30)** – Micah announces his neuroscience book *“Bridging Molecular Mechanisms and Neural Oscillatory Dynamics,”* stating it *“introduces ‘Self Aware Networks: Theory of Mind’”*【47†L27-L34】. (The book itself is published in November 2024.) This formalizes the SAN concept. Key SAN ideas – such as neural phase-wave binding and the “3D TV of the mind” metaphor – are now in print. Micah highlights that SAN addresses the “hard problem” of consciousness by proposing concrete mechanisms【47†L51-L59】. This is a major milestone, giving an official timestamp to the SAN theory’s completion (circa late 2024).

- **2024 (Nov–Dec)** – Micah prepares to unify his theories. He hints on social platforms that he is working on connecting his neural and physics ideas. By December 2024, he is sharing content that foreshadows the New Law of Thermodynamics and the integration of Dark Time Theory with concepts of entropy and brain dynamics (for example, a December 21, 2024 Facebook post by Micah included a one-hour video explaining NAPOT and how it all ties together【21†L33-L41】).

- **2025 (Jan 4)** – **Quantum SuperTimePosition** is introduced as a new quantum interpretation tied to Dark Time Theory【35†L24-L32】. Micah posts an in-depth explainer describing how fast phase cycles could underlie quantum randomness【35†L53-L62】. This comes just weeks ahead of his larger releases, indicating he is addressing potential critiques of Dark Time Theory (namely, how it handles quantum mechanics) just before finalizing the unified version. The timing suggests QSTP is one of the last pieces of the puzzle inserted to strengthen Dark Time Theory.

- **2025 (Jan 27)** – **Micah’s New Law of Thermodynamics** is published (Figshare, Jan 27, 2025)【6†L15-L22】, and an explanatory article is posted on SVGN the same day【9†L30-L37】. This day marks the public revelation of Micah’s attempt to tie everything together via a thermodynamics principle. The New Law explicitly connects to both neuroscience (e.g., neural synchronization is mentioned as an example of the law【14†L178-L186】) and to cosmology (hinting that gravity’s effects can be seen as wave-like signal dissipation【32†L247-L255】). This publication also provides an “executive summary” for the trio of theories (SAN, Dark Time, New Law) as a unified set【21†L37-L41】.

- **2025 (Jan 28)** – **Super Dark Time** is released as an updated unified field theory paper (Figshare version 4/5) and summarized on SVGN【39†L23-L31】. Essentially the polished form of Dark Time Theory, this paper is dated Jan 27 (DOI metadata) and shared Jan 28 on the blog, immediately following the New Law’s publication. Super Dark Time integrates QGTCD with Quantum SuperTimePosition and possibly references the New Law to solidify the link between gravity and wave-dissipation. - **2025 (April)** – By now, Micah’s integrated body of work is in the public domain: SAN theory (consciousness) via the book and videos, Super Dark Time & Super Information Theory (physics unification) via online papers, and the New Law of Thermodynamics bridging between them.
